remarks: Welcome home to this charming 3-bedroom, 1-bath rental in Norwalk, CT, offering a wonderful combination of comfort, convenience, and peaceful living.  Enjoy an inviting and functional layout with three well-sized bedrooms and comfortable living areas. One of the true highlights of this home is the outdoor space. Step outside onto the deck overlooking the spacious backyard-perfect for relaxing, entertaining, enjoying your morning coffee, or simply appreciating the tranquility of your surroundings.  Tucked away in a peaceful setting while still conveniently located near shopping, dining, transportation, major routes, and everyday amenities, this home offers the best of both worlds.  Available immediately! Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy comfortable indoor living, great outdoor space, and a relaxing atmosphere in Norwalk. Schedule your showing today!
